raw_upc_a_full.description: Pass-through: full 12-digit UPC-A, no changes. Default/reference profile.

upc_a_no_check_digit.description: POS strips the check digit; scanner/import expects 11 digits.

upc_a_no_leading_digit.description: Scanner strips the leading number-system digit; expects 11 digits (system digit + payload minus check... see stripLeadingDigit).

upc_a_no_leading_no_check.description: Both leading digit and check digit stripped; 10-digit core payload only.

upc_a_as_ean13.description: Scanner/POS always emits EAN-13 shape (prepend 0 to UPC-A).

upc_a_padded_14.description: Zero-padded to 14 chars to match a fixed-width GTIN-14 storage column.

upc_e_full.description: UPC-E compressed form with leading number-system digit and check digit (8 digits total). Falls back to full UPC-A when not compressible.

upc_e_6_digit_core.description: Bare 6-digit UPC-E core only, no leading digit, no check digit — the classic 'UPC-E' shape printed on packaging.

upc_e_7_digit_with_system.description: 7-digit UPC-E: number system + 6-digit core, no check digit.

upc_e_expand_to_upc_a.description: Scanner is configured to expand any scanned UPC-E to full UPC-A(12) on transmit.

symbology_prefixed_ean13.description: Scanner prepends AIM symbology identifier ']E0' and emits EAN-13 shape.
